title: BeyondTrust PM Cloud AXI credential profile

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: The PM Cloud API account client ID.

clientSecret.title: Client secret
clientSecret.description: An environment variable or absolute file SecretRef for the API account client secret; never an inline secret. Defaults to BEYONDTRUST_AXI_CLIENT_SECRET.

downloads.title: Download permissions
downloads.description: Set allow to true to permit raw-byte downloads from a named file profile to a new private destination file. Downloads are disabled by default.

writes.title: Write permissions
writes.description: Set allowWrites and list exact operations to permit writes from a named file profile. Deletes also require allowDeletes. Writes and deletes are disabled by default.

host.title: PM Cloud API host
host.description: The PM Cloud API host as a lowercase DNS name in the documented <organization>-services.pm.beyondtrustcloud.com form, ending in .beyondtrustcloud.com, with no scheme, port or path.
